evidence_summary: Ranboo was born in the United States on November 2, 2003, and lived in the San Francisco Bay Area. He created his YouTube channel on January 30, 2020 at age 16 and uploaded his first video, a Skywars gameplay, on August 13, 2020. He began streaming on Twitch on September 11, 2020 and gained rapid traction through TikTok's algorithm and a raid from established streamer Punz on September 25, 2020. He was invited to the Dream SMP on November 27, 2020 at age 17 after a viral stream about running for president of L'Manberg, and reached 1 million YouTube subscribers by January 2021, all while still in high school. He graduated high school on June 3, 2021, navigating his final year of secondary education while simultaneously broadcasting to audiences exceeding 100,000 concurrent viewers. His ascent was mathematically anomalous, going from zero to millions of followers in under a year. He later joined the esports organization Misfits Gaming with Tubbo in February 2022 and created the interactive horror-comedy series Generation Loss. Family background is entirely undocumented; his real name is not publicly known.
